capabilities: Render embedded HTML files inline in notes
Expand and collapse previews on demand
Choose between fixed 16:9 and infinite-height display modes
Open the HTML file in its own Obsidian tab
disambiguation: Unrelated to Obsidian's core Page preview feature (hovering links); this plugin renders embedded HTML files inside notes.
extras: Proprietary license despite being installable from source. Preview is implemented with a Markdown post processor, so it is designed for Reading view only. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: replace the default “open file” behavior with an expandable preview for embedded .html and .htm files
problem: Obsidian's default behavior for embedded HTML files is to open them in a separate tab rather than show the page content inside the note.
summary: Renders embedded .html and .htm files inline inside notes, expanding them into a preview frame in Reading view.
